explication: IINA is a modern macOS video and music player built around mpv. The principal workflow is: a user, command-line client, or browser extension supplies a media URL; IINA creates or selects a player window, loads media through PlayerCore and MPVController, renders video or audio, and exposes playback state through UI, playlists, subtitles, history, and system controls. The graph also preserves documented plugin, settings, picture-in-picture, music-mode, and browser-integration capabilities. Some connections are inferred from explicit module responsibilities and README capabilities; unsampled implementation details are omitted.
